career_ladder.note: Graduate Executive Trainees (GET) at NLC India Limited enter in Grade E-2 (₹50,000–₹1,60,000) and undergo 1 year training. On successful completion, they are absorbed as Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) in Grade E-3, advancing along executive engineering cadres.

steps.designation: Graduate Executive Trainee (GET / Mech / Elect / Mining / Civil / CS)
steps.source_label: NLC India Limited GET Recruitment Notification Advt. No. 04/2024
NLC Cadre & Promotion Rules (Absorption on training completion)

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment of GETs is conducted through an All-India Computer Based Online Examination (CBT) followed by a Personal Interview. CBT comprises 120 objective questions with 80% weightage for CBT and 20% weightage for Personal Interview.

stages.source_label: NLC GET Detailed Examination Pattern and Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Part I: Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, General Awareness, Data Interpretation, General English
papers.qualifying_threshold: 50% for UR/EWS, 40% for OBC/SC/ST/PwD in combined CBT

papers.paper_name: Part II: Professional Discipline Subject Knowledge (Mechanical, Electrical, Mining, Civil, CSE, Finance, HR)

financial_package.note: NLC GETs are placed in DPE 3rd PRC IDA pay scale E-2 (₹50,000–₹1,60,000). Starting basic pay during training is ₹50,000 with mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, township accommodation, mining allowances, and cafeteria perks.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NLC India Limited Terms of Appointment and Compensation
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹50,000, 58% IDA (₹29,000), Mining/Thermal Power Station Allowance, Township Quarters in Neyveli/Barsingsar, Cafeteria perks (35% = ₹17,500), less statutory Provident Fund (12% Basic+DA) and pension deductions.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised on quarterly basis
Company Quarters in Neyveli / Barsingsar Township with subsidized utilities
Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of basic pay
Mining / Plant Operating Allowance for thermal and open-cast lignite mine postings
Performance Related Pay (PRP) based on annual generation and corporate MoU score
Comprehensive in-house hospital medical treatment at NLC General Hospital for family
